scientific_integrity: The analytic all-time formula is proved by direct semicircular trajectories, invariant-measure construction, Fourier orthogonality, and finite physical-time phase integration. Numerical checks are supplementary.
scientific_limitations: Statements concern the stationary probability described in the theorem, not all invariant measures or every switching convention.
The phase-space model uses instantaneous resets, not an ordinary globally continuous planar flow.
Discrete Chebyshev correlation identities and the logistic arcsine measure are established prior knowledge; no independent audit or absolute publication priority is asserted.
title: Exact physical-time correlations in a quadratic-reset hybrid oscillator
